snippet.title: Capy Castaway BTS Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Capy Castaway is a cozy narrative exploration game about growing up, finding home, and learning to care together. Play solo or or with a friend, and explore a playful world set in a Toronto inspired environment that rewards your curiosity with shiny trinkets and moments of joy. New demo coming soon to Steam! https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
